label: Notes
description: The user's notes. Reads, writes, searches and deletes them without opening a window.

actions.name: list_notes
actions.summary: List the user's notes by title.

actions.name: read_note
actions.summary: Read one of the user's notes.

title.description: The note's title, or part of it.

actions.name: search_notes
actions.summary: Find the notes containing some text.

actions.name: create_note
actions.summary: Create a note. Replaces an existing note with the same title.

actions.name: append_note
actions.summary: Add a line to a note, creating it if it does not exist yet.

actions.name: delete_note
actions.summary: Delete one of the user's notes.
